thread:
opsbot: :rotating_light: ALERT: org `pacer` generating sustained error spike in region-us-east-1. 5xx rate >15% for 3m, p95 latency rising. Auto-escalating to oncall.

maria: I'm oncall, ack. Pulling up dashboards.

jamal: Customer impact? are they timing out or getting errors?

opsbot: Detector summary: qps +110% vs baseline, 5xx=17%, p95 1.5s (baseline 130ms).

eli: Traces show many requests hitting model backend timeouts after KV cache miss; some worker process showing repeated GC/hangs.

sophia: CS called pacer, they confirm degraded search and ingestion failures. They have a heavy sync job that started ~09:03.

maria: Need quick mitigation: options -> (A) emergency per-org qps bump, (B) route non-critical traffic to model-small, (C) apply stricter org rate-limits for background endpoints. I prefer short QPS bump with auto-rollback.

jamal: +1 to temporary bump. Make it timeboxed and observable. Set a condition to revert if errors don't drop.

maria: Executing emergency bump now (15m window). Command:
```
redwood-cli orgs update-quota --org pacer --qps 1200 --duration 15m --actor maria --note "emergency spike bump"
```

opsbot: Quota change applied by maria at 3690123462. new qps=1200 (prev 400). rollback scheduled at +15m unless cleared.

eli: Also applying a routing rule to prefer model-small for non-search endpoints, and draining one hung worker.

jamal: Good. CS please notify customer.

sophia: Sent update: "Applying temporary capacity and routing changes to restore service. Monitoring closely." Customer acknowledged.

maria: Monitoring metrics. 5xx -> 7% after 90s, p95 -> 310ms. Improvement but not back to baseline yet.

eli: Found root cause candidate: cache invalidation during recent model reload + concurrent pacer job spike causing cache misses and worker exhaustion. Collecting logs.

maria: Set automated check: if 5xx <= 3% and p95 < 200ms for 5m, step down to 2x (800 qps). Else keep measures and escalate.

oncall-bot: Reminder: create internal incident ticket IN-3690123450 and tag for postmortem.

maria: Created ticket IN-3690123450 and added live timeline.

eli: Rolling down to 800 qps (2x) now since 5xx=2.3% and p95=185ms:
```
redwood-cli orgs update-quota --org pacer --qps 800 --duration 10m --actor maria --note "step-down"
```

opsbot: Step-down applied at 3690123472. next check in 10m. auto-rollback cleared.

eli: Ops replaced the GC-troubled instance and cache warmup in progress. Should see further latency improvements.

sophia: Customer confirms partial recovery; they will reschedule the heavy sync to off-peak. Requested a short incident summary.

maria: Closing live mitigation actions. Keeping ticket open for RCA/postmortem. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Incident IN-3690123450 marked mitigated at 3690123478.
